topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The arrangement was more beautiful than I had hoped, a perfect mix of roses and lilies, their colors a thoughtful blend that brightened the room the moment they arrived. I arranged them just so in the vase, making sure each stem was properly submerged. It’s these little details that matter, the care in presentation, the selection of each bloom. The absence of a card was intentional—sometimes, the gesture speaks louder in silence. I like to think it adds a layer of intrigue, a silent whisper of thoughtfulness that lingers in the air, prompting a smile with each glance.
